pages.description: Tu academia de tenis en Maspalomas. Bienvenido a una experiencia de tenis única. Disfruta del mejor clima del mundo en un ambiente inmejorable. Disponemos de dos pistas de tierra batida.
headings: PARA TODAS LAS EDADES Y NIVELES
pages.text:
Darrod Tennis Academy
Bienvenidos a una experiencia de tenis única.Tu academia de tenis en Maspalomas.
PARA TODAS LAS EDADES Y NIVELES
En Darrod Tennis Academy disponemos de una amplia gama de programas, para ofrecerte el mejor servicio:
JUNIOR TENNIS
Conocimiento de la técnica y apoyos. Estudio biomecánica de cada jugador. Comienzo en la competición.
TENNIS PRO
Aplicando todas las variantes de efectos en los golpes. Estrategias para partidos. Patrones de juego varios conociéndose como jugador, resaltando las virtudes y creciendo ante las adversidades y experiencias. Psicología y preparación física adaptada a las necesidades de cada jugador.
TIPOS DE CLASES
CLASES DE TENIS PRIVADAS
CLASES DE TENIS EN GRUPO
CLASES DE PÁDEL PRIVADAS
CLASES DE PÁDEL EN GRUPO
GRUPOS DE ADULTOS VACACIONALES
Mejorando el juego de cada jugador. Variantes de entrenamiento/partido. Conociendo a más jugadores, haciendo amistades. Una experiencia enriquecedora y agradable.
ACOMPAÑAMIENTO "COACHING"
Acompañamiento a torneos locales, nacionales e internacionales según necesidad de cada jugador. Mejorando mientras compito en torneo.

Colaboramos con:
Jugar al tenis durante los 365 días del año con el mejor clima del mundo, con grandes profesionales y experimentados es nuestra insignia.
NUESTRO EQUIPO
Todos los entrenadores de Darrod Tennis Academy utilizan la misma metodología de entrenamiento, diseñada exclusivamente por la Academia. Durante su entrenamiento en Darrod, nuestros estudiantes trabajan con diferentes entrenadores, y cada uno de ellos tiene un alto nivel de profesionalidad.
Daniel Rodriguez
Daniel Gonzalez
Laurent Dairiam
Alberto Ottchota
Javier Anibal
El método de entrenamiento único de Darrod asegura que los jugadores aprendan técnicas específicas para mejorar cada golpe, y las sesiones de entrenamiento físico están diseñadas para todas las edades y niveles.
Cada uno de nuestros entrenadores aconsejan a los jugadores sobre diversos aspectos, como el movimiento en la pista, el juego táctico y la preparación física adecuada, tanto para individuales como dobles.
Análisis en video
Para asegurar que nuestros jugadores reciban el mejor entrenamiento, los entrenadores de Darrod Tennis Academy realizan un análisis del vídeo de este ejercicio. Este tipo de análisis ayuda a encontrar patrones del juego de tenis y a analizar técnicas específicas de un jugador, lo que brinda la posibilidad de diseñar el mejor plan para mejorar estas técnicas.
Hábitos alimenticios
Las comidas en el restaurante gourmet del campus incluyen menús bien equilibrados diseñados para beneficiar al crecimiento de un niño. Cada plato se prepara diariamente con los mejores productos locales para crear una experiencia excepcional guiada por un nutricionista con el plan alimenticio utilizado por los tenistas profesionales.
Múltiples entrenadores
En el entrenamiento diario de nuestros jugadores de todos los niveles, programamos sesiones de tenis con diferentes entrenadores. Cada profesional aporta algo especial y personal al proceso de entrenamiento que enriquece el conocimiento y las habilidades de los jugadores.
Somos Positivos
Influimos positivamente en el crecimiento del estudiante, basándonos en los principales valores para afrontar cualquier situación con éxito, como la dedicación, esfuerzo, constancia, respeto, entusiasmo, auto-confianza y superación. Son valores que determinan qué clase de persona y qué clase de jugador estamos formando.
Somos Expertos
Contamos con un grupo extenso de profesionales experimentados y logramos crear una atmósfera ideal para la formación y desarrollo, en un ambiente divertido y a la vez exigente. Trasladamos nuestra experiencia alrededor del mundo con diversos jugadores. Ofrecemos cantidad de variantes para que quedes satisfecho al 100%.
Enfoque Personalizado
Si bien insistimos en una consistencia en la metodología de entrenamiento, también nos aseguramos de que el proceso de entrenamiento sea personalizado para las características particulares de cada jugador. Los entrenadores trabajan uno a uno con cada jugador para alcanzar el mejor nivel de rendimiento. Al ser expertos en el entrenamiento de tenis, los entrenadores monitorizan la evolución del jugador, buscan patrones en el juego de cada uno y optimizan cada aspecto específico del proceso de entrenamiento.
Del mismo modo, la asistencia individual siempre está garantizada en sesiones grupales. Los jugadores trabajan en grupos reducidos. Los grupos se crean en función de la edad y el nivel de los jugadores.
Ambiente Competitivo
Nos encanta el espíritu de competición. Los programas de entrenamiento están diseñados con el objetivo de mejorar el juego de tenis de los jugadores creando un entorno competitivo de entrenamiento intensivo. Los entrenadores de Darrod Tennis Academy trabajan en el desarrollo de la mentalidad ganadora de los jugadores, lo que permite a los jugadores no solo aumentar su técnica y conocimiento de tenis, sino también entender cómo ser independientes y auto-conducidos, cómo manejar la presión de la vida cotidiana. y cómo empujar los límites físicos y mentales día tras día.
El entorno desafiante y competitivo ayuda a los jugadores a ganar no solo en la pista de tenis sino también en la vida.

¡Más de 9 torneos internacionales abalan la ambición por querer ser un destino recomendable!

pages.description: Your tennis academy in Maspalomas. Welcome to a unique tennis experience. Enjoy the best climate in the world in an unbeatable setting. We have two clay courts.
pages.text:
Darrod Tennis Academy
Welcome to a unique tennis experience.Your tennis academy in Maspalomas.
FOR ALL AGES AND LEVELS
At Darrod Tennis Academy, we offer a wide range of programmes to provide you with the best service:
JUNIOR TENNIS
Knowledge of technique and support. Biomechanical study of each player. Start of competition.
TENNIS PRO
Applying all the different types of spin to shots. Match strategies. Various playing patterns based on knowing yourself as a player, highlighting your strengths and growing in the face of adversity and experience. Psychology and physical preparation tailored to the needs of each player.
TYPES OF CLASSES
PRIVATE TENNIS LESSONS
GROUP TENNIS LESSONS
PRIVATE PADEL LESSONS
GROUP PADEL LESSONS
ADULT HOLIDAY GROUPS
Improving each player’s game. Training/match variations. Meeting more players, making friends. An enriching and enjoyable experience.
COACHING SUPPORT
Accompanying players to local, national and international tournaments according to each player’s needs. Improving while competing in tournaments.
Advance booking and reservations

Premium Service in Hotels
Train wherever you are. With our hotel service, we keep track of your training even when you’re on holiday. (Exclusive service with additional cost).
We collaborate with:
Playing tennis 365 days a year in the best climate in the world, with highly skilled and experienced professionals, is our hallmark.
OUR TEAM
All coaches at Darrod Tennis Academy use the same training methodology, designed exclusively by the Academy. During their training at Darrod, Our students work with different coaches, each of whom has a high level of professionalism.
Daniel Rodriguez
Daniel Gonzalez
Laurent Dairiam
Alberto Ottchota
Javier Anibal
Darrod’s unique training method ensures that players learn specific techniques to improve each stroke, and the physical training sessions are designed for all ages and levels.
Each of our coaches advises players on various aspects, such as movement on the court, tactical play and proper physical preparation, for both singles and doubles.
Video analysis
To ensure that our players receive the best training, Darrod Tennis Academy coaches analyse video footage of this exercise. This type of analysis helps to identify patterns in tennis play and analyse specific techniques used by a player, enabling us to design the best plan for improving these techniques.
Eating habits
Meals at the campus gourmet restaurant include well-balanced menus designed to benefit a child’s growth. Each dish is prepared daily with the finest local produce to create an exceptional experience guided by a nutritionist using the meal plan used by professional tennis players.
Multiple coaches
In the daily training of our players of all levels, we schedule tennis sessions with different coaches. Each professional brings something special and personal to the training process that enriches the players’ knowledge and skills.
We are Positive
We positively influence student growth, based on key values for successfully facing any situation, such as dedication, effort, perseverance, respect, enthusiasm, self-confidence and self-improvement. These values determine the kind of person and player we are shaping.
We are Experts
We have a large group of experienced professionals and have managed to create an ideal atmosphere for training and development, in a fun yet demanding environment. We bring our experience to players around the world. We offer a wide range of options to ensure you are 100% satisfied.
Approach Customised
While we insist on consistency in our training methodology, we also ensure that the training process is tailored to each player’s particular characteristics. Coaches work one-on-one with each player to achieve the highest level of performance. As experts in tennis coaching, coaches monitor each player’s progress, look for patterns in each player’s game, and optimise every specific aspect of the training process.
Similarly, individual attention is always guaranteed in group sessions. Players work in small groups. Groups are created based on the age and level of the players.
Atmosphere Competitive
We love the spirit of competition. Training programmes are designed with the aim of improving players’ tennis game by creating a competitive environment for intensive training. The coaches at Darrod Tennis Academy They work on developing a winning mindset in players, enabling them not only to improve their technique and knowledge of tennis, but also to understand how to be independent and self-driven, how to handle the pressures of everyday life, and how to push their physical and mental limits day after day.
The challenging and competitive environment helps players win not only on the tennis court but also in life.

More than nine international tournaments back up the ambition to become a recommended destination!

Darrod’s unique training method ensures that players learn specific techniques to improve each stroke, and the physical training sessions are designed for all ages and levels.
Each of our coaches advises players on various aspects, such as movement on the court, tactical play and proper physical preparation, for both singles and doubles.
Video analysis
To ensure that our players receive the best training, Darrod Tennis Academy coaches analyse video footage of this exercise. This type of analysis helps to identify patterns in tennis play and analyse specific techniques used by a player, enabling us to design the best plan for improving these techniques.
Eating habits
Meals at the campus gourmet restaurant include well-balanced menus designed to benefit a child’s growth. Each dish is prepared daily with the finest local produce to create an exceptional experience guided by a nutritionist using the meal plan used by professional tennis players.
Multiple coaches
In the daily training of our players of all levels, we schedule tennis sessions with different coaches. Each professional brings something special and personal to the training process that enriches the players’ knowledge and skills.
We are Positive
We positively influence student growth, based on key values for successfully facing any situation, such as dedication, effort, perseverance, respect, enthusiasm, self-confidence and self-improvement. These values determine the kind of person and player we are shaping.
We are Experts
We have a large group of experienced professionals and have managed to create an ideal atmosphere for training and development, in a fun yet demanding environment. We bring our experience to players around the world. We offer a wide range of options to ensure you are 100% satisfied.
Approach Customised
While we insist on consistency in our training methodology, we also ensure that the training process is tailored to each player’s particular characteristics. Coaches work one-on-one with each player to achieve the highest level of performance. As experts in tennis coaching, coaches monitor each player’s progress, look for patterns in each player’s game, and optimise every specific aspect of the training process.
Similarly, individual attention is always guaranteed in group sessions. Players work in small groups. Groups are created based on the age and level of the players.
Atmosphere Competitive
We love the spirit of competition. Training programmes are designed with the aim of improving players’ tennis game by creating a competitive environment for intensive training. The coaches at Darrod Tennis Academy They work on developing a winning mindset in players, enabling them not only to improve their technique and knowledge of tennis, but also to understand how to be independent and self-driven, how to handle the pressures of everyday life, and how to push their physical and mental limits day after day.
The challenging and competitive environment helps players win not only on the tennis court but also in life.
